capabilities: Draw system design diagrams from text or by clicking on a canvas
Save named versions and show a visual diff of added, removed and changed parts
Walk through a request flow step by step
Render the archslate code block as a diagram in reading view and live preview
Export the current view as PNG or SVG to the attachment folder
disambiguation: Not a general diagramming tool; it is made for system design diagrams and covers fewer diagram kinds than Mermaid, D2 or PlantUML.
extras: Works fully offline with no account or network requests. An optional AI agent skill (shipped outside the plugin) teaches Claude Code and other agents to write these diagrams. A web version of the editor opens and saves the same notes. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later.
intentEvidence: Obsidian draws mermaid code blocks itself, and several plugins draw diagrams.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid only renders text one-way and other diagram plugins lack two-way click-and-text editing, per-note version history, and a visual diff of diagram changes.

relations.evidence: Obsidian draws mermaid code blocks itself, and several plugins draw diagrams.
Excalidraw and Draw.io draw freely, anything you like
D2 text ("a modern diagram scripting language")

summary: System design diagram editor that draws diagrams from text or by clicking, saves named versions with visual diffs, and stores each diagram as a Markdown code block.
